categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Top Cloud-Agri Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the smart agriculture sector, offering integrated solutions including intelligent hardware devices, agricultural IoT projects, and information software platforms. Their products and services cover the entire crop planting lifecycle, focusing on data collection, analysis, decision-making, and precise execution for government agencies, enterprises, and research institutions in agriculture.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages IoT, artificial intelligence, big data, multispectral imaging, deep learning, and sensor technologies to develop smart agriculture solutions. Their production methods include in-house R&D and manufacturing of intelligent hardware, customized software platform development, and integration of AI-driven phenotyping and pest monitoring technologies. They emphasize a combination of hardware and software for comprehensive digital agriculture management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include provincial and local government agricultural departments, seed and plant protection stations, research institutes, and system integrators in the agriculture sector. The company serves the domestic Chinese market extensively, with products applied in crop planting, pest control, and agricultural digital transformation projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily across China, with significant revenue contributions from East China, Northwest, Northeast, North China, South China, Central China, and Southwest regions. It also has minor overseas sales. Zhejiang Province serves as a strategic base with demonstration advantages and government collaboration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Top Cloud-Agri Technology operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the agriculture supply chain, focusing on technology development, hardware manufacturing, software platform provision, and integrated service delivery for smart agriculture applications. It acts as a solution provider rather than raw material supplier or end consumer.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in AI-driven agriculture, multispectral sensing, pest monitoring, intelligent irrigation and fertilization, and digital platform upgrades. It invests heavily in innovation, collaborating with universities and research institutions to develop advanced phenotyping, pest control, and lifecycle management technologies. Future focus includes AI integration, edge computing, and smart agricultural robotics.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of smart agriculture projects (including IoT and software platforms) and intelligent hardware devices. The company uses a direct sales model involving bidding and commercial negotiations, providing customized solutions and after-sales services. Other minor revenues come from technical services such as training and maintenance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading integrated smart agriculture solution provider in China, distinguished by its comprehensive product line and strong R&D capabilities. It competes with numerous fragmented players in hardware, software, and IoT sectors but stands out due to its full lifecycle coverage, proprietary technologies, and government-backed projects.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 489 million, a 6.41% increase from the previous year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 123.46 million, up 7.35%. Total assets grew 44.75% to RMB 1.2 billion, and equity increased 60.87% to RMB 944 million. R&D investment was about RMB 50 million, representing over 10% of revenue, indicating steady growth and strong innovation commitment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers a unique value proposition through its integrated hardware-software solutions that cover the entire crop lifecycle, enabling precise, data-driven agricultural management. Its products incorporate cutting-edge AI, IoT, and multispectral technologies, providing high accuracy in phenotyping, pest detection, and resource optimization. Strong government partnerships and extensive industry experience further differentiate it as a trusted leader in China's smart agriculture transformation.
